Message:
feat(deadline-confirm): bootstrap one-click email confirmation app (0.1.0)

New monday-code app (App ID 11704868, dev-center slug yomsheni-il_status-email)
per docs/spec.md — the spec is the source of truth:

- GET/HEAD /confirm: constant-time secret gate → 30/min/IP token bucket →
  board/expiry/status guards → change_column_value + attribution create_update;
  response space is exactly three static RTL pages
- monday OAuth (authorization-code, single-use state nonces) + sessionToken-
  guarded admin API (state/config/secret-rotate/snippet)
- Admin View SPA (React 19 + Vibe, Hebrew RTL) served from the server at /admin
- All storage in SecureStorage with a 60s read cache (owner decision 2026-07-14)
- API pinned to 2026-07; operations probe-verified in the sandbox (WZ- board);
  fixtures captured in tests/fixtures/
- 212 tests via test-guard gates: 10 red→green suites + 33 killed mutations,
  0 survivors; typecheck/lint/build/monday-api check clean
- Deviation from spec wording (documented in CLAUDE.md): status labels parsed
  from typed settings (settings_str is deprecated); fromIndex/toIndex hold
  stable label IDs

Root CLAUDE.md: app table row + slug list. monday-api skill: recorded
empty-value read shapes quirk (RECORD step).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
